atoms.title: A few days before boarding school

atoms.text:
Hello Ali and Jessy,
In a few days, I have to change schools and move to another city. As you know, I have lived in Leeds since my birth, and now I have to go to Wiltshire and leave you and my parents behind. What am I going to do without you guys? There is not even a shopping centre in Wiltshire where I could spend my time after school. I have no clue what the boarders do there to have fun after school. Now, I also have to share my room. At home, I had a room all by myself, but now I have to share one with three classmates. And the worst part is, the boarding school does not even have a basketball club. So, I can't play basketball anymore, but I have to learn cricket.
Yours,
James

instruction.text: Lies dir die zweite E-Mail von James durch.

atoms.text:
Hello Ali and Jessy,
I've been here in Wiltshire for a week now and I already miss you guys. It is hard to make new friends here because they have all known each other for years. Yesterday, I tried out cricket, but I was pretty bad at it. I didn't even hit one ball. And this morning I was late to the first lesson because the school is so big. Now, I would love to spend some time in the skatepark and eat ice cream with you. But I can't because I'm in Wiltshire.
Yours,
James

instruction.text: Womit hat James nach einer Woche im Internat Schwierigkeiten? Liste auf.
Lies dir die dritte E-Mail von James durch.

atoms.text:
Hello Ali and Jessy,
Thank you for your great advice. Because of you I've talked to my roommates more, and we became good friends. They even introduced me to their friend group. Since then, we always hang out together after school. They even taught me cricket. I'm not as bad as in the beginning, but I'm not a pro either. At least it is more fun to me now. It isn't that bad to share a room after all. At this stage, I also know my way around the campus and most importantly I don't get lost anymore.
Yours,
James
